description: The transcripts of Kazakh Speech Corpus (KSC). No recipe reads them. Its transcripts are the Kazakh Speech Corpus's transcript files, inside archives that total about 19 GB, and a fetch holds a whole download in memory, so no fetch can read them (see https://github.com/Mearman/keepset/issues/212).
